correctness.rationale: The exact polar-area formula and affine Funk-ball parametrization reduce the volume to the one-dimensional analytic integral displayed in RESULT.md. Differentiation at \((\delta,s)=(0,0)\) gives the three Hessian entries. Since \(V_{ss}>0\), the minimizing center is an analytic implicit branch and the optimized second variation is the stated Schur complement. Its numerator is a quadratic in \(A=\operatorname{artanh}\lambda\) with positive leading coefficient and upper root below \(\lambda\), while \(A>\lambda\); hence the second variation is strictly negative for every finite radius. The finite quadrature verifier agrees with the three closed Hessian formulas at representative radii but is not used for the universal sign.
residual_risks: RESULT.md contains a literal form-feed character in one displayed proof formula where \(\frac\) was intended; the surrounding formulas and final theorem make the mathematical content unambiguous.
